calls.title: FY 2027 Planning Prep
calls.summary: The meeting centered on establishing a balanced approach to growth planning amidst pressures from internal leadership and venture capitalists. Brent Holloway emphasized the importance of collaboration to support sales with adequate leads, proposing a conservative yet ambitious 40% growth target. Discussions also highlighted the risks associated with overly aggressive growth plans, with Ryan McGurk and Ashley Stirrup debating the implications of aiming for $20 million ARR versus a more cautious $16 million ARR. The team recognized the significance of hiring ramp time and sales enablement, as well as the need to manage churn effectively to support growth. Financial plans were reviewed, showing differing burn rates and growth profiles, while benchmarking against peers underscored the necessity of realistic growth expectations in the current market context.
calls.keywords: growth planning, sales ramp, ARR targets, cash burn, financial modeling, sales efficiency
